g.text: Design the failure path as carefully as the success path
five layers, each one a product decision, then the error classes
constrain outputs to known schemas; abstain if unsourced
run checks before output reaches the user
citation checks, schema checks, rules, a second model as judge
tell users when the answer is uncertain,
offer a fast path: edit, ask again, escalate to a human,
log user corrections and reports as labelled data for evals
error classes to design for: what the user sees, what the system does, what is logged
